content.text: I want to cherry pick and get the files from this branch ci-local-host onto main, but only the files in .github/workflows. What is the git command I should use? Do not run any git commands. Just return the relevant git command that I will use myself

```bash
git switch main
git restore --source=ci-local-host --staged --worktree -- .github/workflows
git commit -m "Bring workflows from ci-local-host onto main"
```
